scopes.cpu_pmu: whole client span including handshake, warmup and teardown; denominator requested+warmup
scopes.server_process_cpu: user+system CPU of the server process/descendant tree observed by the harness; excludes kernel/IRQ work charged elsewhere
scopes.whole_vm: all VM CPUs, user+nice+system+irq+softirq; excludes idle/iowait/steal and double-counted guest fields; includes unrelated work
scopes.abba_ratios: candidate/baseline; center=ratio of two-arm medians; range=[min(candidate)/max(baseline),max(candidate)/min(baseline)]; descriptive, not confidence intervals
scopes.interpretation: process CPU and whole-VM busy are distinct scopes; neither is total-server CPU or proof of a win

arms.name: baseline

hardware_counters.scope: server user-mode CPU only; excludes kernel, hypervisor, guest, IRQ and softirq work; same-process future thread values aggregate into their creator thread family

client_cpu_headroom_gate.scope: per-CPU VM busy across the whole client span, plus existing measured-phase client-process user+system CPU saturation check
client_cpu_headroom_gate.limitations: the two windows differ; neither proves instantaneous headroom or excludes client, network or Windows host bottlenecks; unknown evidence cannot pass
